item.title: The Euro takes a priced-in hike into a week that belongs to American inflation
item.description: 1.1000 has turned EUR/USD back in each of the past three sessions, and it did so in a week when most of the news leaned the Euro's way. Eurozone core inflation was revised higher, the ZEW sentiment survey beat its forecast, and the US factory numbers missed.

item.title: The British Pound goes into PMI week paying for softer inflation and slower pay
item.description: UK inflation and pay growth both came in under forecast, which is good news for British households and was the reason the Pound fell.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average drops for a fifth day as AI rout widens
item.description: Five falls in five sessions have taken the Dow Jones Industrial Average more than 10% below its August record close, and the selling is no longer confined to artificial intelligence (AI) stocks. The index dropped to just under 48,000, its lowest since April, and is trading near 48,100.
